ex.s: We should live with them in harmony and enjoy nature’s gifts, as he describes in his journals: Live in each season as it passes; breathe the air, drink the drink, taste the fruit, and resign yourself to the influences of each.
ex.t: 我们应当与他们和谐相处,享受大自然的礼物,正如他在日记中描述的那样:在每一季中随其过去而生活;呼吸空气,饮酒,品尝水果,并接受每个季节的影响。

ex.s: Life on Earth • Wear ordinary clothes and change according to the seasons.
ex.t: 地球上的生活 • 穿普通的衣服,并根据季节变化.

defs.def: a period of the year in tropical countries when it is either very dry or it rains a lot （热带地区的）旱/雨季

ex.s: During the rainy season, it is along these waterways that rainwater moves down the mountains and into the terraces.
ex.t: 在雨季,雨水沿着这些水道向山下移动,进入梯田。

ex.s: 31     young plants in the dry season was    32     for a lone boy.
ex.t: 旱季的31种幼稚植物是32株,对于一个孤独的男孩来说.

ex.s: A longer dry season.
ex.t: 更长的旱季。

ex.s: Since the 1930s, Mclntyre said, the biggest factors driving up water stress in the state have been rising temperatures, which cause trees to lose more water to the air, and earlier snowmelt, which reduces the water supply available to trees during the dry season.
ex.t: 从20世纪30年代开始,麦金泰尔说,促使该州水压上升的最大因素是气温升高,导致树木向空气中流失更多的水,更早的雪融也减少了树木在旱季期间的供水.

defs.def: a period of time during a year when a particular activity happens or is done （一年中开展某项活动的）季节，旺季

ex.s: Even if this method of timekeeping is novel in its particulars，early agricultural societies also connected time to natural phenomena．In pre-Classical Greece，for instance，people“corrected”official calendars by shifting dates forward or backward to reflect the change of season．Temporal connection to the environment was vital to their survival．Likewise，river time and other timekeeping systems we're developing may encourage environmental awareness．
ex.t: 即使这种计时方法在细节上是新颖的,早期的农业社会也将时间与自然现象联系起来。 例如,在古希腊,人们通过向前或向后移动日期来反映季节变化来“修正”官方日历。与环境的暂时联系对于他们的生存至关重要。 同样,我们正在开发的河流时间和其他计时系统可能会鼓励环境意识。

ex.s: But he is also working at a far more fundamental level: his staff show people how to make floating gardens and fish ponds prevent starvation during the wet season.
ex.t: 但是,他也在更根本的层面上工作:他的工作人员向人们展示如何在潮湿的季节使漂浮的花园和鱼塘防止饥饿。

defs.def: a period of time in which a play is shown in one place; a series of plays, films/movies or television programmes （一部戏剧在一地的）演出期，上演期；（一系列的戏剧、电影或电视节目的）会演，荟萃
